title: The Interregnum
description: Watch results for the Interregnum — a reach of endless snows, bitter cold, and ancient brass.

prompts.text: An appreciation of the warmth below decks before you head back out into the cold.
A quick joke by one of the undercrew about the Twinhorn prince (who doesn't exist) and the three bulls of the Schism (that similarly don't exist).
A break in the snow and a lull in the wind.
A sense of overwhelming peace, and the sudden realisation that everything in the Interregnum is on the verge of collapse — but that it probably isn't really your problem.
A chunk of volcanic stone lodged in a treetop snowdrift, gently steaming.
A ship of the Striding Schism, gleaming brass and with heat to spare.
An obelisk pine-cone hollowed out and used as a resource cache.
A chunk of ancient brass from the Taurobol Tower itself, inscribed with text in an ancient Chthonic dialect.
The remains of a battle at sea, a story told in snow-furrows and scattered ship parts.
A mechanical searchlight swings back and forth across the waves, though it's likely not connected to any alarm or warning system. Sounds rusty.
An untouched, spit-sized chunk of cooling volcanic stone, its insides crusted with glittering diamond.
Icicles hang from the bare branches of a lone tallshank that somehow made it above the tree-line.
Rare herbs grow in a discarded seed-tray wedged in the branches below you.
Hares scamper into branch-burrows as you pass.
A writhing mass of serrofly larvae swarms your ship after your passage disturbs their haunt.
A gap in the soul — Hundred Horns stirs beneath you.
